publication_note: This ACT performs no git push, no --force, and no refspec rewrite. A human operator is expected to inspect the recorded commit SHAs in the gate summary, then push the branch at their discretion. This ACT is intentionally publish-on-demand, not publish-on-commit; do not read it as claiming any 'current HEAD' or 'ahead-of-origin' count, since both change each time another commit is added. Local-publication subjects are recorded by stable SHA in this file. This gate-summary tree is discoverable on demand via 'git log -1 --format=%H -- .factory/gate-summary.json'.
